title: Chesterton's fence
idea: Do not remove a fence until you know why it was put up.
apply: Before you cut a rule, process, or habit, find out what it was meant to solve and who set it up.
remind: Know why it is there before you take it down.
who: Ravi, a new ops manager with a pointless looking approval step.

items.x: Finance signs off on every order

scenes.nar: Ravi is the new operations manager. He finds a step where Finance signs off on every small order, and it looks pointless.

items: A month later: one vendor is paid twice

scenes.nar: He deletes the step. Orders speed up. A month later the company pays the same vendor twice, because that sign-off was catching duplicates.
Next time he asks first. Who added it? What problem did it solve? Is that problem gone?
He learns it caught duplicates, so he keeps that check. But he drops the sign-off for orders under fifty dollars.
